videos.text: How Confirmation Bias Controls Your Opinions There's a word manipulators are terrified you'll learn. You've felt it before — that quiet discomfort you couldn't explain. Here's what it was. Research into human behavior confirms it: familiarity breeds acceptance. The more you hear something, the more true it feels. What makes it dangerous is how ordinary it looks. But now that you've seen it, you'll start noticing it everywhere. Follow Cognitive Dark for the psychology they don't teach you in school.
